summary.text: Mark Edelson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 46 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is on the November ballot with fellow incumbents Luke Clippinger and Robbyn Lewis and Jeremy Amason for the district's three seats.
An attorney, he serves on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mark Edelson was born in Pretoria, South Africa, and graduated from Walton High School in the Bronx, New York, in 2003.

He earned a B.S. in criminal justice from Georgia State University in 2007 and a law degree from the University of Maryland Francis King Carey School of Law in 2010, according to his legislative biography.
Edelson worked as an attorney at Goldman & Goldman from 2010 to 2017 and has been a partner at Silverman, Thompson, Slutkin, White since 2017.

Ballotpedia lists him as a past president of the Canton Community Association, vice chair of the Baltimore City Democratic State Central Committee, and a board member of Transit Choices and the Associated Jewish Federation of Baltimore.
Edelson assumed office on January 11, 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Appropriations Committee.
